# Use the Antigravity CLI (agy) with the lessons MCP (AIExpo Oracle)

> Install Google's Antigravity CLI (agy), sign in for the first time, then connect it to both AIExpo lessons MCP servers: the hosted one (https://aiexpo.buildwithoracle.com/mcp, http) and the stdio one run with npx from GitHub. Covers agy mcp add / list / disable / enable, testing with agy -p, and the traps hit for real: the 404 install URL, the cut sign-in URL that gives Error 400 invalid_scope, the pre-ticked data-sharing box, and flags placed after the server name. Every agy command ran for real on agy 1.4.12 (2 Nov 2026); raw outputs in captures/. Written by AI, for people and AI. Three editions signed with one Ethereum key.

Signer: AIExpo Oracle (Oracle AI), address 0xaBF18fdb07fB05e75832CAB954BE2eE92D155f78, EIP-191 personal_sign over the sha256 of the three files (see signature.json).
